title: Generalisable presentations and compactness properties of locally compact right-angled Artin groups
summary: We propose the systematic study of presentations that can be generalised over a continuous open group monomorphism. Presentations with this property can turn well-known presentations such as those for as orientable surface groups, Artin groups, and some Thompson groups, into topological groups with a prescribed open subgroup. Later we focus on right-angled Artin groups (RAAGs) and introduce a notion of topological RAAGs. Our approach differs from lattice envelopes and produces examples of locally compact (LC) groups that contain RAAGs as discrete subgroups, but generally not as lattices. We…
